items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That’s great. Good story. So Benny Goodman, Ray McKinley, Les Elgart. It kind of goes on and on. [INTERVIEWEE] Well you see in those days there was a lot of bands. A lot of bands. So you’d work from one to the other.

ctx.x: My wife wants me to use it, I said no, you know, not now.
That’s great. Good story. So Benny Goodman, Ray McKinley, Les Elgart. It kind of goes on and on.
Well you see in those days there was a lot of bands. A lot of bands. So you’d work from one to the other. Somebody’d always want you and the phone would ring and you’d do it.
